verdict.rationale: TruffleHog Enterprise docs mention routing findings to webhooks and setting up alerts across platforms, indicating some webhook-based notification/event capability, and custom detectors support webhook-based verification callbacks. However there is no documented API for subscribing to specific event types, managing webhook endpoints, or an event schema — the webhook mention is a single line in getting-started docs with no further detail. Missing for 10: dedicated webhook subscription API/docs, list of event types, endpoint management, and independent corroboration of the feature working in practice.
